messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-12-29, the ledger remains an Ember team service. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29-2]
- The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-13]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2026-01-05, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-01-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-05]
- The ledger has no deploys from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- As of 2026-04-16, the ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC; the old Wednesday 09:00-11:00 UTC slot is retired. [constraint; valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-16]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to 2026-04-16; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-18]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-10]
- On 2025-04-26, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour during INC-2025-011. [valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service sits with Team Dune; Team Boreal no longer owns it. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler went to Team Atlas, not Team Cinder; Team Cinder never owned it, and the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder; the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-09-12, the ledger must not be upgraded past Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes. [constraint; valid 2025-09-12 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-12]
- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]

Question: Who owns the ledger today?

message.reasoning: The memory says: As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team. Also confirmed 2025-12-29: ledger remains an Ember team service. Today is 2026-06-30. So the answer is the Ember team.
